title: Noether R356-R357 Paper 30 source-witness upgrade and Web R277 disposition support

artifacts.classification: source-witness upgrade / routing aid / no TeX patch
Web R277 disposition / stale-base guard / no TeX patch

inspected_local_input_not_recommended_as.disposition: accept as confirmation only; do not use the Web R277 cumulative as the new Noether base

scope: R356 stages better Paper 30 source witnesses from IA/SIM raw JP2 leaves 0031-0066 for printed pp. 26-61, including PNG derivatives and a PDF wrapper. R357 inspects the Web R277 P24/P32 source-fix package and records that its useful fixes are already represented in the current R347 base while P24/P30/P34 should not be replaced from the older Web span.
summary: R356 identifies the IA/SIM raw JP2 page set, 2208x3372 gray images at about 400ppi equivalent, as the best currently staged visual witness for Noether Paper 30; the GDZ PPN235181684_0096.pdf volume remains a lower-bit-depth fallback. R357 accepts Web R277 only as confirmation of the Paper 24 source-left display and Paper 32 beta-exponent fixes; it rejects wholesale replacement because R347 carries later local P24/P30/P34 work.
evidence: SIM raw JP2 leaves and PNG derivatives for printed pp. 26-61
native-image PDF wrapper for Paper 30 printed pp. 26-61
Web R277 ledgers and SHA256 ledgers
caveats: No TeX patch is made by either R356 or R357.
R356 is source-witness/routing support only; it does not certify Paper 30. No strict native650 witness was found locally in this pass.
R357 rejects Web R277 as a replacement base. It is disposition/anti-regression support, not a new reader release.
R277 is an inspected local input and fix confirmation only; do not front it as the current Noether cumulative.
This wave is not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, not strict native650/1000 source closure, and not critical-edition material.
